title: SERENITY - Mondomarine 42m
highlights: Not for sale to US residents while in US waters
description:
SERENITY is a 42.3-metre aluminium motor yacht built by Mondomarine in 2015, with exterior and interior design by the yard. She accommodates twelve guests in five cabins, with a crew of eight.

Powered by twin MTU 12V2000 M94 engines, she cruises at 14 knots with a top speed of 16.5. She is MCA and MLC compliant and flagged in the Cook Islands. Not for sale to US residents while in US waters.
